title: Outage Report Maintenance Log Form
subtitle: An original outage report workflow that carries planned or condition-based maintenance through safe release, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete outage report maintenance log form for the utility interruption and restoration event that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when service personnel need one record for maintenance trigger, asset baseline, work-control references, recurring events, readings, deferred defects, and qualified return-to-service approval. The outage coordination lead owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Outage report maintenance log identity and ownership
sections.guidance: Define the maintained system, service interval, operating owner, and review period.

sections.title: Outage report asset baseline and maintenance readiness
sections.guidance: Reconcile the exact asset and known condition before maintenance or testing begins.

blocks.label: Planned maintenance task set
items: Validate outage event, service type, location, and reporting source
Screen life safety and route emergency indicators immediately
Link duplicate reports and map distinct affected pockets
Identify critical facilities, dependent services, and priority consequences
Coordinate crew, operations control, access, and public-protection actions
Record device or area status without directing unauthorized switching
Track affected count, restoration stage, estimated time, and confidence
Publish approved customer and partner updates at the assigned cadence
Verify restoration by system evidence and representative customer feedback
Transfer remaining pockets, damage, and corrective work to named owners

sections.title: Outage report work control and safe service boundary
sections.guidance: Record the qualified roles and controlling references; do not use this log as the controlling procedure.

blocks.label: Service readiness confirmations
items: Current procedure, manufacturer information, and applicable requirements were reviewed
Asset boundaries, every energy source, and affected systems were identified
Authorized, affected, contractor, and operations roles were coordinated
Isolation, stored-energy control, and verification references are complete
Required tools, instruments, parts, and protective controls are available
Test, temporary energization, and return-to-service steps have explicit authority
Customer, public, traffic, environmental, and critical-service impacts are controlled
Stop conditions and emergency escalation path are understood

blocks.label: Maintenance stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This record supports situational awareness; it does not authorize switching, valve operation, entry, or approach to damaged utility equipment. Keep callers and the public away from downed lines, gas odors, flooding, fire, and unstable areas. Route emergency indicators immediately and leave isolation and restoration decisions to designated operations control and qualified crews. Maintenance stays restricted when isolation, stored energy, system condition, or work scope is unknown. Only the designated authorized person may direct changes to controls and the qualified release owner may approve return to service.

sections.title: Outage report maintenance events, condition, and readings
sections.guidance: Create a traceable history of work completed, condition found, evidence, and deferred action.

fields.label: Wear pattern, recurring fault, consumable trend, configuration change, and supporting evidence

sections.title: Outage report exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Downed or sagging conductor, arcing, fire, or damaged electrical asset
Gas odor, hissing, damaged main, regulator, or atmosphere concern
Water-main break, flooding, washout, sinkhole, or energized water exposure
Steam, pressure, chemical, traffic, debris, or unstable structure
Public entry into an uncontrolled utility work or damage zone
Unknown system state, backfeed, switching, valve, or isolation status
Critical-service consequence beyond the current response capability
Any condition requiring emergency command or operations control
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This record supports situational awareness; it does not authorize switching, valve operation, entry, or approach to damaged utility equipment. Keep callers and the public away from downed lines, gas odors, flooding, fire, and unstable areas. Route emergency indicators immediately and leave isolation and restoration decisions to designated operations control and qualified crews.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each maintenance exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Outage report decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Utility interruption and restoration event identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
